name: better-ccflare
description: Load balancer proxy for Claude API with intelligent distribution across multiple OAuth accounts to avoid rate limiting

scripts.build:linux-amd64: bun run build-target.ts linux amd64 dist/better-ccflare-linux-amd64
scripts.build:linux-arm64: bun run build-target.ts linux arm64 dist/better-ccflare-linux-arm64
scripts.build:macos-x86_64: bun run build-target.ts darwin amd64 dist/better-ccflare-macos-x86_64
scripts.build:macos-arm64: bun run build-target.ts darwin arm64 dist/better-ccflare-macos-arm64
scripts.build:windows-x64: bun run build-target.ts windows amd64 dist/better-ccflare-windows-x64.exe
scripts.prepublishOnly: cp ../../README.md . && bun run --cwd ../.. build:dashboard && bun run build && jq 'del(.dependencies["@better-ccflare/cli-commands", "@better-ccflare/config", "@better-ccflare/core", "@better-ccflare/core-di", "@better-ccflare/database", "@better-ccflare/logger", "@better-ccflare/server"])' package.json > package.json.tmp && mv package.json.tmp package.json
